tools.name: inspect_saved_work
tools.purpose: Inspect available persisted recordings and transcripts through the packaged application UI.

tools.name: hash_source_original
tools.purpose: Capture the source/original relative path, size and SHA-256 before any product write so later preservation can be verified.

tools.name: hash_raw_transcript
tools.purpose: Capture SHA-256 for the preserved raw transcript before any edited-layer write.

tools.name: edit_and_save
tools.purpose: Edit a transcript through the packaged application UI and save the edited layer.

tools.name: verify_source_preservation
tools.purpose: Deterministically verify that source/original path, content hash, file size and metadata size remain unchanged after the controlled edit.

tools.name: verify_provenance
tools.purpose: Deterministically verify raw transcript immutability and edited transcript separation after the controlled edit.

tools.name: reopen_transcript
tools.purpose: Restart the packaged application, reopen saved work and verify expected persisted edited content.

tools.name: stop
tools.purpose: Stop when sufficient evidence exists or further qualification cannot be supported.
